[LLOG.3.1] A time-dependent test (`now()`, `dwell`, a `within` window, a series
read; [LTIM.2.4.1]) can go from true to false while no fact changes. Evaluated only on fact change, such a
test would keep its activation, and the `logical` fact that activation
justifies, alive after the test has gone false. [LLOG.3.11.1] is how the engine
prevents that.
